newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO raises French 1996 rapeseed crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: SIDO raises French 1996 rapeseed crop estimate.

text.p: The French oilseeds and protein seeds association SIDO slightly raised its estimate for the 1996 rapeseed crop to 2.87 million tonnes, against a September target of 2.80 million and 1995 output of 2.70 million.
The new estimate assumed yields would rise to 3.3 tonnes per hectare from 3.2 tonnes last year and area to 865,000 hectares from 845,000, SIDO said in its November report.
A tight supply situation in the rest of the European Union was expected to benefit French rapeseed exports, SIDO said.
Total exports might jump to 1.825 million tonnes in 1996/97 from 1.298 million in 1995/96.
Crushings were put at 750,000 tonnes, down from 1.005 million in 1995/96.
France would end the 1996/97 season with rapeseed stocks of 50,000 tonnes against 85,000 in 1995/96.
